slots.title: Mahjong lobby: Quick match card
where: /games/mahjong → components/games/mahjong/lobby/mahjong-lobby.tsx, the art strip at the top of the Quick match card in the Play section
slots.css: desktop: one third of the page width (~300–420) × 152, cover; 721–1020px: 256×160 thumbnail at the card's top left; phones: full card width (~340) × 112
slots.crop: Cover-cropped from 2.4:1 to anything between 1.6:1 and 3.7:1, centered. Keep the subject inside the center 60% of the width and the middle 70% of the height; the edges are atmosphere only. No UI sits on top of it.
slots.lighting: neon: ticker-board blue glow from behind, cool rim light on the tiles
slots.fallback: Drawn in mode-art.tsx: a stopwatch ring showing the bot-fill seconds beside four seat slots, three filled with real East, South and West tiles and one dashed slot with searching dots, over a fill meter, on a blue halftone wash.
slots.brief: Speed and matchmaking on a trading floor at night: a chunky stopwatch with its sweep hand mid-turn floats left of center, and to its right four ivory riichi mahjong tiles stand in a row on a dark felt rail, three upright and lit, the fourth position an empty glowing outline with motion streaks pulling a tile in. Faint ticker-board grid and speed lines behind. Hololive blue (#3fb8f5) light on dark ink (#0a0c11), flat shapes with halftone shading.
slots.notes: No text, numbers or symbols readable on the stopwatch face; no real talents. Must read on both the dark and the light theme: keep the background dark ink, since the card frames it with a hairline.
